comingUp.detail: Quarterly equity holdings. SEC deadline is 45 days after quarter-end (Sat 14 Nov, so the next business day is Mon 16 Nov). Not filed as of this scan. Expected from the SEC rule, not a Berkshire announcement. Share counts on this page stay at 30 Jun until that filing.
No 2026 letter was on berkshirehathaway.com at this scan (letters/2026ltr.pdf returned 404). Kingswell (6 Nov) noted last year’s letter was 10 Nov. Third-party watch item, not a company date.
